data.name: pkg-hello-lane
data.yaml_source:
# A package's own graph. Its steps are named by absolute path under the package root, which is
# where the package is mounted in every container of this stack.
workflow:
  name: pkg-hello-lane
  description: Prove that a workflow package runs without the platform knowing it
  entry_point: write
  input:
    profile:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: research-default
      description: execution profile — taken and recorded, not used by this package
    text:
      type: string
      required: false
      default: "hello from a package"
      description: what the deterministic step writes
  limits:
    max_iterations: 6
    timeout_seconds: 300

agents:
  - name: write
    type: script
    description: Write the given text into the run's workspace and report what it wrote
    command: "${POC_PY:-/opt/venv/bin/python}"
    args: ["/work/packages/hello-lane/steps/write.py", "{{ workflow.input.text }}"]
    output:
      path: {type: string}
      sha256: {type: string}
      chars: {type: string}
    routes:
      - to: done

  - name: done
    type: terminate
    status: success
    reason: "wrote {{ write.output.chars }} chars to {{ write.output.path }}"

output:
  path: "{{ write.output.path }}"
  sha256: "{{ write.output.sha256 }}"
  chars: "{{ write.output.chars }}"
